description: Independent test: are NMD-escaping RAD51D truncations tolerated in the general population (gnomAD) relative to ClinVar pathogenic calls?
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0 (research)","Content-Type":"application/json"}
q="""query { gene(gene_symbol:"RAD51D", reference_genome: GRCh38){
 variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ variant_id hgvsc hgvsp consequence flags exome{ac an} genome{ac an} }}}"""
vs=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",json={"query":q},headers=H,timeout=90).json()["data"]["gene"]["variants"]
CDS=984; last_junction=902; nmd_escape=last_junction-50
LOF={"frameshift_variant","stop_gained","splice_donor_variant","splice_acceptor_variant","start_lost"}

esc=[]; tgt=[]
for v in vs:
    if v["consequence"] not in LOF: continue
    h=v.get("hgvsc") or ""
    m=re.search(r"c\.(\d+)",h)
    if not m: continue
    p=int(m.group(1))
    if p>CDS: continue
    e=v.get("exome") or {}
    ac=e.get("ac") or 0; an=e.get("an") or 0
    if an<100000: continue
    af=ac/an
    (esc if p>=nmd_escape else tgt).append((h,p,ac,an,af))

print(f"gnomAD v4 pLoF alleles in CDS: NMD-escape zone n={len(esc)}, NMD-target zone n={len(tgt)}")
ac_e=sum(x[2] for x in esc); ac_t=sum(x[2] for x in tgt)
an=max([x[3] for x in esc+tgt])
frac=(CDS-nmd_escape+1)/CDS
print(f"escape-zone length fraction of CDS = {frac*100:.1f}%")
print(f"allele count: escape {ac_e}, target {ac_t}; escape share of alleles = {ac_e/(ac_e+ac_t)*100:.1f}%")
print(f"distinct-site share in escape zone = {len(esc)/(len(esc)+len(tgt))*100:.1f}%")
bt=stats.binomtest(len(esc),len(esc)+len(tgt),frac)
print(f"binomial test, distinct pLoF sites in escape zone vs CDS length: p={bt.pvalue:.3f}")
mw=stats.mannwhitneyu([x[4] for x in esc],[x[4] for x in tgt],alternative='greater') if esc and tgt else None
if mw: print(f"Mann-Whitney, escape-zone AF > target-zone AF: U={mw.statistic:.0f}, p={mw.pvalue:.3f}")
print("\nEscape-zone pLoF alleles (population-tolerated candidates):")
for h,p,ac,an_,af in sorted(esc,key=lambda x:-x[4])[:10]:
    print(f"  {h:20s} c.{p:4d}  AC={ac:4d}  AF={af:.2e}")

# ClinVar vs gnomAD comparison figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.6))
cats=["ClinVar P/LP\ntruncating alleles","gnomAD v4\npLoF alleles"]
obs_share=[11/160*100, len(esc)/(len(esc)+len(tgt))*100]
ax.bar([0,1],obs_share,0.5,color=["#2b6cb0","#2f855a"])
ax.axhline(frac*100,ls="--",c="k",lw=1.2)
ax.text(1.35,frac*100+0.6,f"expected from length ({frac*100:.1f}%)",fontsize=9,ha="right")
for i,v in enumerate(obs_share): ax.text(i,v+0.4,f"{v:.1f}%",ha="center",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(cats)
ax.set_ylabel("Share of alleles in the NMD-escape zone (%)")
ax.set_title("Truncating RAD51D alleles that escape nonsense-mediated decay\nare depleted among pathogenic calls but not among population pLoF variants",fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylim(0,22); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
